items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including unauthenticated arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-103849, CVE-2026-92909), privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: BlockStrap is a CVSS 10.0 Magento and Adobe Commerce flaw that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution, fixed in APSB26-153.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: SessionReaper is a critical (CVSS 9.1) flaw allowing customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution, with active exploitation observed as of October 22, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This emergency hotfix resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650), dubbed 'StyleSmuggler', that could result in arbitrary code execution and is known to be actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution, with attacks starting September 4th.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including several unauthenticated issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: CISA Adds Exploited Magento RCE Flaw to KEV Catalog
items.summary: A critical deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, has been added to CISA's KEV catalog due to active exploitation for remote code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) leading to privilege escalation and several stored cross-site scripting issues.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento could allow an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction.
